wikipedia.title: Chikmagalur district
wikipedia.text: Chikmagalur district, officially Chikkamagaluru district (IPA: [t͡ʃikːɐmɐɡɐɭuːru]) is an administrative district in the Malnad subregion of Karnataka, India. It was called Kadur (Cuddoor) district till 1947. Coffee was first cultivated in India in Chikmagalur. The hills of Chikmagalur are parts of the Western Ghats and the source of Tunga and Bhadra rivers. Mullayanagiri, the highest peak in Karnataka is located in the district. The area is well known for the Sringeri Mutt that houses the Dakshina Peeta established by Adi Shankaracharya.

wikipedia.title: Diocese of Chikmagalur
wikipedia.text: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Chikmagalur (Latin: Chikmagaluren(sis)) is a diocese located in the city of Chikmagalur in the ecclesiastical province of Bangalore in India.

wikipedia.title: Chikmagalur Assembly constituency
wikipedia.text: Chikmagalur Assembly constituency is one of the 224 seats in Karnataka State Assembly in India. It is part of Udupi Chikmagalur Lok Sabha constituency.

wikivoyage.title: Chikmagalur
wikivoyage.text:
Chikmagalur, officially Chikkamagaluru (ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು Cikkamagaḷūru), is a city in Karnataka, known for its coffee plantations and Bababudan Giri ranges.


== See ==


=== Temples ===
1 Amrutapura Temple, Amrutapura. This temple is in the village of Amrutapura, 67 km north of Chikmagalur. (updated Apr 2015)

2 Veera Narayana Temple (Belavadi), Belavadi. The village Belavadi is home to this well-known temple. It is approximately 30 km from Chikmagature. (updated Apr 2015)


=== Hill stations ===
 B.B.Hills (Bababudangiri). Minibus starts from the Private busstand everyday by 12:30PM. Once you reach B.B.Hills, you have just one hour to explore the hills because the same bus returns by 5PM. There is only one tea shop at B.B.Hills, so you have to beg for a plate of hot porottas. But you can skip the eating as the scenes are terrific. (updated Apr 2015)

== Eat ==

 Malnad Paradise, Indira Gandhi Rd.  
 Mayura Vegetarian, Near Head Post Office. for Masala Dosai, a fermented crepe made from rice batter, black lentils, potato and onions. ₹35 (updated Apr 2015)
 Raj Mahal Hotel, Indira Gandhi Rd.  
 Salpicon, K.M Rd (head north-east on KM Rd. Pass by Gas Station (on the left). Destination is on the right, opp APMC Market and nearby to AIT college), ☏ +91 98 45231359. Mon 4PM-9:30PM; Tue-Sun 11:30AM-9:30PM. Burger shop with a unique flavour of herbs on it.
